exam_scheme.note: Conducted by the Teachers' Recruitment Board, Tripura (TRBT), Education (School) Department, Government of Tripura in accordance with the National Council for Teacher Education (NCTE) guidelines under Section 23(1) of the RTE Act, 2009. The examination consists of two standalone objective papers: Paper-I for candidates intending to teach Classes I to V (Under-Graduate Teacher) and Paper-II for candidates intending to teach Classes VI to VIII (Graduate Teacher). Each paper comprises 150 multiple-choice questions (150 marks) of 150 minutes (2 hours 30 minutes) duration administered offline via OMR sheets with no negative marking. The qualifying threshold is 60% (90 out of 150 marks) for Unreserved candidates, with a 5% relaxation to 55% (83 out of 150 marks) for SC, ST, and PH candidates. In accordance with TRBT statutory guidelines, the T-TET eligibility certificate is valid for life.

competition_benchmarks.note: Official candidate appearance, qualification count, and percentage datasets published by the Teachers' Recruitment Board, Tripura (TRBT), Education (School) Department across 8 district examination centres. As an eligibility certification examination pursuant to NCTE guidelines, T-TET qualifies candidates for teacher recruitment rather than filling specific vacancies directly; hence vacancies are not applicable.
